articles.summary: Shared wallets are multisig setups where private keys are held by multiple participants (cosigner). A majority of keys are needed to move funds.

articles.summary: A Secure Element (SE) is a microprocessor chip in hardware wallets that securely stores private keys, protecting against physical attacks.

articles.summary: "Not your keys not your coins" (NYKNYC) means that if you don't hold the private keys to your bitcoin, you instead have an IOU from a custodian.
articles.title: Not Your Keys Not Your Coins (NYKNYC) Explained

articles.summary: Secure your Bitcoin with proper seed phrase storage. Write it down, create a metal backup, and store it in a secure location.
articles.title: Where To Store Your Seed Phrase
